governance_records.title: Frozen FVG ATR Interface Incompatibility

static_proof.calculate_atr_public_surface: scalar: returns 0.0 for invalid/insufficient input, otherwise float(atr_series.iloc[-1]) (utils/indicators.py lines 5-19)
static_proof.detect_fvgs_consumption: bot/analysis/fvg_engine.py line 29: atr = calculate_atr(df, atr_period); line 30: atr_series = atr if hasattr(atr, 'iloc') else None; line 38: if atr_series is None or i - 1 >= len(atr_series): continue
static_proof.consequence: A scalar float has no .iloc, so atr_series is always None; every detector iteration skips every candidate window and detect_fvgs returns [] for every frame long enough to enter the loop. Short frames (len(df) < atr_period + 3) also return []. Therefore the current frozen detect_fvgs implementation cannot produce an FVG for any input through this path.

governance_records.global_calculate_atr_change_prohibited: the first repair must not change the existing scalar public behavior of utils.indicators.calculate_atr; other callers may depend on it; the defect must be repaired locally in the FVG detector path

hypotheses.statement: The frozen V1 requirement that a valid order block and fair-value gap satisfy an exact contemporaneous geometric overlap may be stricter than the underlying economic idea being represented. A causally related displacement structure may exist even when the two detected price regions do not literally overlap at the decision timestamp.
hypotheses.economic_rationale: An order block and the displacement imbalance represented by an FVG describe related but not necessarily geometrically identical aspects of a price move. A displacement can originate from or react around a prior structural zone without requiring the two price intervals to intersect exactly.
hypotheses.implementation_boundary: D001 must not implement alternative overlap acceptance rules; no candidate count under an alternative overlap rule may be calculated.
code_components: bot/state/gate_reducer.py (gate_11_confluence_score: fvg_in_ob geometry, atr*0.30 tolerance, first FVG only)
hypotheses.expected_qualitative_effect: If H001 is relevant, decisions reaching the structural stage should show that OB availability, FVG availability, and exact-overlap availability fail at materially different rates rather than all failing because neither structure exists.
hypotheses.expected_frequency_effect: Qualitative only at this stage: relaxation of a sufficient-but-possibly-overstrict geometric conjunction would be expected to increase candidate frequency; no number is predicted and none may be computed by D001.
hypotheses.potential_failure_mode: If OB and FVG availability themselves are near-zero, or the overlap conjunction is not a material attrition point (rates similar to structure absence), the geometric relationship is not the binding constraint and H001 is unsupported for V2 purposes.

hypotheses.statement: The frozen valid-order-block predicate may be conjunctively restrictive: individual OB structural or lifecycle subconditions may occur reasonably often while their required simultaneous conjunction makes valid_order_block rare.
hypotheses.economic_rationale: OB identification, displacement confirmation, directional context, mitigation state, invalidation state and age are conceptually distinct properties. Requiring every property simultaneously may encode a narrower event than the intended structural concept.
hypotheses.implementation_boundary: D001 does not remove or weaken any OB condition; it only decomposes the existing canonical predicate's observable states and reasons.
code_components: bot/strategy/config.py (order_block configuration: expiry bars and related parameters)
hypotheses.expected_qualitative_effect: If H002 is relevant, the diagnostic should reveal concentration in one or more specific OB subpredicate failures (e.g. a single lifecycle state dominating BlockState outcomes) rather than an absence of all OB-like structure.
hypotheses.expected_frequency_effect: Qualitative only: relieving a dominant single subpredicate failure would be expected to increase valid-OB availability; no number is predicted and none may be computed by D001.
hypotheses.potential_failure_mode: If OB-like structure is genuinely rare (no_confirmed_block dominates with little concentration elsewhere), the conjunction is not the bottleneck and H002 is unsupported.
metrics_permitted: canonical failure-reason counts and co-occurrence counts

hypotheses.statement: OB and FVG evidence may be causally related across a short temporal sequence rather than being required to appear as a strictly simultaneous state at one decision timestamp.
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Price displacement unfolds through ordered bars. A structural origin can precede the imbalance it produces, and a later causal FVG observation need not imply that the originating OB and FVG were first detected on the same completed bar.
hypotheses.implementation_boundary: Registered now but NOT necessarily fully tested by D001. A later diagnostic may investigate temporal distance explicitly. The full H003 test must not be smuggled into D001 merely because the data is available; D001 is restricted to its preregistered metric surface.
code_components: bot/state/gate_reducer.py (ob_identity / fvg_identity / timing_info provenance in gate context)
hypotheses.expected_qualitative_effect: If H003 is relevant, OB and FVG detections should exhibit short, structured temporal offsets rather than being restricted to same-bar co-occurrence; measurable only by a later dedicated diagnostic.
hypotheses.expected_frequency_effect: Qualitative only: a temporal-association rule would be expected to broaden admissible evidence relative to strict simultaneity; no number is predicted.
hypotheses.potential_failure_mode: If causal OB/FVG pairs are temporally diffuse or absent, temporal association is not economically meaningful for this strategy.
metrics_permitted: OB-to-FVG temporal distance distributions (later diagnostic only)

hypotheses.title: Canonical FVG Attrition Bottleneck
hypotheses.statement: The absence of canonical FVGs observed in D001 is produced by one or more specific stages of the existing FVG-generation/retention pipeline, rather than demonstrating that three-candle imbalance structure is entirely absent from Fold 01.
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The frozen pipeline applies several conceptually distinct conditions before a zone appears in the final fvgs list: (1) sufficient causal M5 history; (2) valid ATR; (3) middle-candle displacement-body threshold; (4) three-candle geometric gap; (5) direction filtering; (6) fill-status filtering. These stages encode different economic concepts and should be decomposed before any FVG semantic change is proposed.
hypotheses.known_frozen_behavior: get_unfilled_fvgs(entry, timeframe='M5', direction=htf_bias) ultimately uses the existing FVG detector and returns only unfilled zones aligned with the requested direction.
hypotheses.expected_diagnostic_implication: If H004 is relevant, the zero final FVG list should be attributable to one or more concentrated pipeline stages rather than every underlying prerequisite simultaneously being absent.

hypotheses.title: FVG ATR-Series Interface Repair
hypotheses.statement: The frozen canonical FVG detector's zero-output behavior is caused by an interface mismatch between scalar calculate_atr() and the detector's expectation of an indexable ATR series. Supplying a mathematically equivalent rolling ATR series to the detector, while preserving all existing FVG thresholds and downstream filtering semantics, should restore the detector's ability to evaluate canonical FVG windows without introducing a new trading threshold.
hypotheses.economic_rationale: This is a correctness repair to allow the already-declared FVG definition to execute as written. It does not assert that relaxing the FVG definition is profitable or desirable.
expected_qualitative_effect: Stage-B detector windows become evaluable after ATR warm-up
later existing stages C-G may finally produce empirical observations
final candidate frequency may remain zero
